name: motion-reels
description: Instagram Reel studio: motion-graphics videos made entirely in code (canvas + ffmpeg), inspired by lemo-opuscar.

scripts.samples: node scripts/render.js --project examples/sample-reel.json --out public/samples/sample-reel.mp4 && node scripts/render.js --preset chai --out public/samples/chai-reel.mp4 && node scripts/render.js --preset launch --out public/samples/launch-reel.mp4 && node scripts/render.js --preset hooks --out public/samples/hook-reel.mp4
